title: Auth store + login flow
description: Zustand auth store (token, user, login/logout), useAuth hook, LoginPage, protected route wrapper (ProtectedRoute component), session validation on mount.
definitionOfDone: store/auth.ts exports useAuthStore with token, user, login(), logout(), isAuthenticated
ProtectedRoute component redirects to /login if not authenticated
useAuth() hook wrapping useAuthStore for convenience

implementationPlan.description: Enhance dashboard/src/state/config.ts to serve as the auth store. Add fields: token (string), user (User | null), isAuthenticated (computed from token), tenantId. Actions: login(token, user), logout() (clears token + user + localStorage), setTenantId(). Token persisted in localStorage under 'cordum-token'. On store initialization, hydrate from localStorage. This replaces the separate store/auth.ts from the plan since AppShell already imports from state/config.ts.
implementationPlan.note: Enhanced config store with user, isAuthenticated, login(), logout(). Backwards-compatible: update() still works for AppShell and api/client.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: convenience hook wrapping useConfigStore. Exports: useAuth() returning { token, user, isAuthenticated, login, logout, tenantId }. Also exports useRequireAuth() which redirects to /login if not authenticated (uses useNavigate + useEffect).

Create dashboard/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Full login page with username/password form. On submit, POST /api/v1/auth/login with { username, password }. On success, store token and user in auth store, redirect to '/'. On error, show error message. Also supports API-key-only mode: if auth config shows !password_enabled, show API key input instead. Uses existing Button, Input, Card components. Includes Cordum branding. No XSS vectors — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
implementationPlan.note: Full login page with password mode and API-key-only mode. Uses existing UI primitives. returnUrl support via query params.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx: Wrapper component that checks isAuthenticated from useAuth(). If not authenticated, redirects to /login with return URL in query param. If authenticated, renders children wrapped in AppShell. Session validation: on mount, calls GET /api/v1/auth/session to verify token is still valid; if 401, clears auth and redirects to /login.
Update dashboard/src/App.tsx to wrap protected routes with ProtectedRoute component. /login route remains unprotected. All other routes go through ProtectedRoute which provides AppShell wrapper.
implementationPlan.note: Replaced AppShell wrapper with ProtectedRoute which provides auth guard + AppShell.

implementationPlan.description: Verify: run tsc --noEmit. Test login flow logic: unauthenticated → redirect to /login, login → store token → redirect to /, invalid token → clear + redirect.
implementationPlan.note: tsc --noEmit passes clean. All DoD items verified.
